'''Mos Doba''' was a [[City|town]] located on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War]], it had been taken over by a group of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. Sometime between [[0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]], it was was freed by [[Tatooine rebel cell|Saponza's Gang]], which had allied itself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWC" /><ref name="Kekit Databank">{{Databank|kekit|Kekit}}. In Kekit's Databank entry, it is stated that Saponza and his partner played an integral part in the campaign that liberated a Jawa clan from the Tusken Raiders. It also states that the plan was orchestrated by Jennica Pierce of the Rebel Alliance. This scenario does not occur if the player aligns with the Empire, so it can be deduced that Saponza's gang joined the Rebellion.</ref>

The town had several buildings, and was encircled by walls, with a [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]] sitting in its center. Its perimeter was protected by four rapid-fire turrets and four proton [[mortar]]s.<ref name="SWC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Doba appears in the [[2014]] [[Canon]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''.<ref name="SWC" />
